test_title: PYST 36: SSC CHSL - English (Held On: 21 March, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: english
question:
Improve the underlined part of the sentence. Choose 'No improvement' as an answer if the sentence is grammatically correct.

I didn't have __times to watch__ the whole movie.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 1'** i.e.** "time to watch".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the sentence** "I didn't have times to watch the whole movie",** the use of **"times"** is incorrect.
 
• The **correct term **to use here is **"time"**, which refers to the indefinite continued progress of existence and events in the past, present, and future regarded as a whole.
 
• The term **"time"** in this context refers to a period of time or an opportunity to do something.

Therefore, the** correct sentence** is:* 'I didn't have **time to watch** the whole movie.'*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The other options are incorrect due to the following reasons:

 
 
• **Option 2: "timer to watched" **- The word "timer" refers to a device for measuring time, and it does not fit in this context. The verb form **"watched"** is also **incorrect **as it's in the past tense and does not correctly match with "to", which requires the base form of the verb.
 
• **Option 3: "time to watching"** - This is grammatically incorrect because after the word **"to"**, the base form of the verb should be used. So "watching" should be** "watch".**
